scope: Selected native Codex/Claude skill practice supplement. The existing landscape did not contain a structured TypeSafe choice; this record makes that already authorized capability and two focused skill additions explicit. Source review, installer registration, native client discovery, provider execution and demonstrated task improvement are separate evidence levels. Nothing here establishes a universal skill or repository ranking.
selection_policy: Select the strongest evidenced fit for a concrete gap. Preserve upstream skill bytes and licenses, use one supported installation method per skill, load only the task-relevant procedure and retain current user/project authorization. Awesome lists are discovery indexes, not ranking proof or instructions to install whole packs.

recorded_commands: npx --yes skills add typesafe-ai/skills --skill typesafe-ai --agent codex claude-code --global --yes --json
npx --yes skills add typesafe-ai/skills --skill typesafe-ai --agent codex claude-code --copy --yes --json
npx --yes skills add openai/skills --skill gh-fix-ci security-best-practices --agent codex claude-code --global --yes --json
installation_method.strategy: Use the supported skills add workflow for the selected repository and named skills. TypeSafe uses this same method at global and adopted-project scopes; do not layer a second manual installer or copy an authentication store. The other two skills are user-level and available to selected projects through native discovery.
installation_method.observed_state: The coordinator reported successful global installation for both native agents. Independent read-only inspection found matching global installer registrations for all three and a project TypeSafe registration. All three inspected global SKILL.md hashes matched their pinned upstream files; the project TypeSafe copy matched as well.
installation_method.claim_boundary: Installer records and matching bytes are source identity evidence. Fresh client and bounded worker results are retained separately below; a future installer run resolves sources again and needs its resulting pin/bytes checked.

skills.name: typesafe-ai
skills.rationale: Typed semantic judgments fit routing, ranking, extraction and evidence questions that deterministic code cannot answer from syntax alone. The upstream skill keeps known rules, computation and execution in code, asks for representative task evaluation and points to live API/cookbook documentation. It complements the native coding clients rather than replacing their reasoning or account routes.
skills.activation: Load for semantic judgments or a feature that benefits from typed common-sense decisions. Read the current task-relevant API/SDK page and cookbook. The selected native evidence-review workers receive the skill and sanitized advisory packet explicitly; they have no credentials or API authority. The coordinator alone makes any authorized TypeSafe calls, with credentials scoped to that process.
limits: Typed output guarantees an interface, not truth; confidence is not authority to execute an action.
Do not replace numeric risk, permissions, exact lookups or execution rules with model judgments.

Eight selected catalog claims are a diagnostic, not general qualification: jev-1.13.0 matched 7/8 frozen labels, versus 3/8 weak containment; C4 disagreement is preserved. No matched worker-cost or task-quality superiority is established.

Eight uncached authorized provider calls returned zero service errors. Credentials stayed in the coordinator process; native workers reviewed a sanitized advisory packet. Claude directly read selected skill sections; Codex loading/source recovery is present in the returned child report, without a raw child trace.

native_verification.scope: Fresh native source-review role invocation in both clients (Claude top-level --agent, Codex coordinator-reported child) and separate eight-case TypeSafe diagnostic.
observations: Claude initialization lists all three skills; direct Read and Grep recovered relevant TypeSafe sections where headless preload was not visible.
Corrected Linux Codex invocation returned all eight source judgments; the first desktop-configured attempt failed source access and remains retained.
Both completed reviews keep C4 unqualified and preserve C6 availability rejection. Actual Claude model is claude-fable-5-1; Codex resolved model/effort and Claude effort were not exposed.
No global runtime/model replacement follows from this bounded check.

skills.name: gh-fix-ci
skills.rationale: The catalog maintains real GitHub Actions checks and retained failure evidence. This focused official skill reuses an upstream standard-library helper for check inspection, GitHub CLI field drift and job-log fallback instead of adding custom parsing or another CI service.
skills.activation: Use when an authorized task asks to inspect or repair failing GitHub Actions PR checks. Existing task authorization takes precedence over the imported skill's repeated approval language; do not insert another planning or permission loop into already authorized work. Preserve native gh sign-in.
limits: The retained helper run exercised only a successful-check state; failure-log extraction, actual repair quality and client-trigger behavior were not qualified by that run.
The helper returns plain text for a clean result even when --json is supplied; callers must not assume every output is JSON.
External CI providers remain outside this helper's accepted scope; their details URLs are reported rather than silently treated as GitHub Actions.
No provider-token or task-quality improvement against a matched baseline has been measured.

retained_helper_check.execution: The unchanged pinned script was inspected, fetched into process memory and executed with Python against the selected native-agent-stack worktree and --pr 55 --json. It used native gh/git read operations; no skill installation or repository edit was performed by this check.
retained_helper_check.independent_observation: A separate native gh pr checks 55 --json name,state,bucket,link query returned five checks, each in SUCCESS state at the time of inspection.
retained_helper_check.claim_boundary: Actual clean-check helper compatibility on the inspected host, not a failing-check repair, a native agent skill invocation or a future PR status guarantee.

native_verification.scope: Claude initialization lists the skill; first Codex coordinator report lists it. The unchanged native helper completed a clean PR-check inspection. No failing repair was manufactured.
unqualified: Actual native-agent activation of the CI procedure

skills.name: security-best-practices
skills.rationale: Existing gitleaks, zizmor and inventory checks do not supply application authorization, input/output, browser or framework security review guidance. This narrowly triggered official skill supplies relevant Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and Go references without a standing scan service or broad rule pack.
skills.activation: Use for an explicitly requested security review, security guidance or secure-by-default development in a supported language. Load the relevant framework references only after identifying the actual task. Current user scope and existing authorization prevail over generic imported process advice.
limits: The bundled FastAPI specification names 0.128.x and the Next.js specification names 16.1.x; the reviewed foundation pins are FastAPI 0.141.1 and Next.js 16.3.5. Verify version-dependent advice in current framework sources.
Reference coverage is limited to the documented languages/frameworks. Generic advice must not be promoted to a verified vulnerability without source, deployment context and impact evidence.
The skill is not a full security audit or an instruction to review every ordinary coding task. Local loopback/development conditions must not be mislabeled as production vulnerabilities.
Source identity and fresh client discovery are retained. Useful security findings and false-positive control have not been measured; do not describe this as a completed security review.

native_verification.scope: Claude initialization lists the skill; first Codex coordinator report lists it. No security review task was invoked solely to qualify catalog presence.
unqualified: A supported security finding and safe control

alternatives.name: Vercel focused UI and React guidance
alternatives.rationale: The small UI review skill is a useful future accessibility/interface checklist. It fetches mutable external rules, so a review needs the fetched revision retained. The 70-rule React guide is appropriate for concrete React/Next performance work; the current static catalog dashboard does not demonstrate a need to load that broader guide.
alternatives.overturn_when: A requested UI/accessibility or React-performance review reveals a missing procedure, and a bounded trial produces supported findings beyond existing browser acceptance without unnecessary whole-guide loading.

alternatives.name: Anthropic web application testing
alternatives.rationale: Its Playwright interaction and server helper overlap the accepted agent-browser/Playwright lanes. The instruction to always wait for networkidle has not demonstrated an advantage over task-specific readiness checks, so this source review does not justify replacing or duplicating the current browser skill.
alternatives.overturn_when: A concrete multi-server lifecycle or browser-testing gap is demonstrated and the upstream helper improves that case against the current lane.

alternatives.name: Trail of Bits differential review
alternatives.rationale: Git-history, caller-impact and concrete-attack evidence are useful for a substantial security-sensitive diff. Mandatory comprehensive reporting/history phases and the optional namespaced plugin agent are a heavier and differently integrated procedure than the existing bounded independent review; do not import the whole pack as a default.
alternatives.overturn_when: A security-sensitive diff requires the deeper procedure and a selected native-compatible trial improves supported findings while keeping report effort and plugin dependencies proportionate.

alternatives.name: Agent Skills reference specification and tools
alternatives.rationale: The already installed skills-ref validator remains useful for portable format checks. The inspected repository tree contains no SKILL.md additions to install, and reference validation does not establish Claude/Codex extension support or native discovery.
alternatives.overturn_when: A new supported format or client-discovery problem needs a targeted validator update; a new standard revision alone is not evidence of a runtime improvement.

coordinator_owned_qualification.scope: Opt-in roles inherit model/effort, receive sanitized advisory results and have no service credentials or API authority. TypeSafe matched 7/8 frozen cases; both returned native reviews kept C4 unqualified and C6 rejected.
coordinator_owned_qualification.claim_boundary: Claude native Read/Glob/Grep trace is retained privately and summarized publicly. Codex CLI returned a completed child report but no raw child trace or resolved model. Source-review interoperability is observed; universal runtime/model ranking and matched savings are not.
